title: Inspection of prefabricated construction assemblies.
officialText:
Prior to the approval of a prefabricated construction assembly
having concealed mechanical work and the issuance of a permit, the department shall require the submittal of an evaluation
report by an approved agency on each prefabricated construction assembly, indicating the complete details of the mechanical
system, including a description of the system and its components, the basis upon which the system is being evaluated, test results
and similar information, and other data as necessary for the commissioner to determine conformance to this code.
